root_cause_clue.fairness_reference: Legacy equal-progress differs from the specified owner Q/alpha policy when owners have different eligible stage sets. root_cause_clue.finding: The compiler summary reports R*Tk consumption waves, while append_epoch receives R output rounds. Its five macro sections aggregate K work at output-round granularity; the independent oracle releases compute only after each discrete K-wave load and produces/stores an output only after that output tile's final K wave. Shape and K extent classes are reported separately for this probe.
